description: This file defines the Total extension controller class for the OpenCart admin interface, handling CRUD operations such as install, uninstall, and listing of total extensions within the admin panel.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'total' extensions in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing available extensions, installation, and uninstallation logic.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that renders the list of 'total' extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares data for listing all 'total' extensions, including their status and available actions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a 'total' extension, including permission checks, file existence verification, database extension registration, and permission assignment.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process of a 'total' extension, including permission checks, removal from database, and calling any extension-specific uninstallation routines.
